profile_text.body:
Rev is a for-profit company founded in 2010 and headquartered in Austin, Texas. The company describes itself as an investigative intelligence and legal transcription platform built for investigations that need to hold up in court. Its site presents a legal AI platform that turns digital evidence into verified, citable findings, and offers tools including multi-file evidence analysis, an AI image analyzer, AI-driven document templates for tasks such as incident timelines, evidentiary discrepancies, statements of facts, and oral argument preparation, as well as a transcript editor and mobile app. The company also provides human and AI transcription, captioning, and subtitle services with transparent pricing.

Rev's core AI product is Rev AI, a speech-to-text API and transcription service that combines human and AI hybrid workflows with an emphasis on data confidentiality. On the legal side, the site notes that Rev is trusted by bar associations and legal organizations across the country, and identifies it specifically as the State Bar of Texas's first official legal AI partner. The AI template library allows users to build or select from ready-made structures that Rev populates from uploaded evidence, with every fact linked back to its source.

The held facts note that Rev carries notable legal exposure in Texas, with 76 associated cases recorded under that jurisdiction, which is consistent with its prominent relationship with Texas legal institutions. No patent or SEC filings are recorded for the company in the held data.
